bands.title: Strongly introverted
bands.summary: Your answers suggest you strongly prefer quieter, calmer settings and recharge best with time alone or with a few close people.

bands.title: Leans introverted
bands.summary: You likely enjoy people in smaller doses and value time on your own to recharge.

bands.title: Ambivert
bands.summary: You sit near the middle of the spectrum and can draw energy from both social time and solitude, depending on the situation.

bands.title: Leans extroverted
bands.summary: You likely enjoy company and conversation, and often feel energised by being around others.

bands.title: Strongly extroverted
bands.summary: Your answers suggest you thrive on social energy and activity, and on being around people.

extraversion.low: You probably recharge in quieter settings and prefer deeper one-to-one conversations to large groups.
extraversion.moderate: You can enjoy both social time and solitude, adapting to the situation.
extraversion.high: You likely gain energy from people, conversation and activity, and feel comfortable taking the lead socially.
extraversion.reflect: After which kinds of social time do you feel energised, and after which drained?
extraversion.tip: Plan your week with your social energy in mind, leaving room to recharge in the way that suits you.

suggestions: Neither introversion nor extroversion is better. Each has its own strengths.
Notice which settings leave you energised, and plan more of them.
Protect your recharge time, whether that means quiet time alone or time with friends.
note: Your position is the average of 20 answers (reverse-worded questions flipped), shown on a 0–100 scale where 0 is the introverted end and 100 the extroverted end.
